title: Goodbye at the Fair
about: A final farewell at the fair that only became recognizable as a true ending years later.
description: This track reflects on the strange quietness of a goodbye that didn't announce itself as permanent. As the fair ended, costumes were packed, people made plans for the future, and everyone prepared to go home like they had before. Yet one final meeting carried a different weight. Only years later did it become clear that some endings happen without a curtain, a speech, or any warning that this will be the last time.
lyrics: The trailers filled one by one,
One last time between the walls.
The fair was ending like always did...
I kept looking through the crowd,
Hoping things would feel the same.
One last wave, one final smile,
I was standing in the middle
The rides were slowing one by one,
The midway losing all its noise.
You found me one last time,
Neither of us said much at all.
When there's nothing left to call.
Funny how endings rarely announce themselves.
The lights faded one by one.
The buildings stayed, the people left,
